decisions.finding: Initial Vav of ויִּצְחַק consists of a printed vertical stem with 58 vertical rows of pure white paper (all pixels = 255) underneath. Confirmed unpointed consonant.
Initial Vav of ויֹּאמר consists of a bare vertical stem with 36 vertical rows of pure white paper underneath. Confirmed unpointed consonant.

Underneath Mem of ויֹּאמר sits a clearly printed three-dot Segol forming a downward equilateral triangle (two upper dots at y=1088..1091, one lower central dot at y=1093..1095). Confirmed printed Segol (U+05B6).
